get_key.title: Create a connection key (API key)
get_key.hint: Follow these steps. Tap a step when you finish it. Links open in a new window only when you tap them.

anthropic.s1: Sign up or log in at the Claude Console (platform.claude.com).
anthropic.s2: In Billing, add a payment method and buy credits.
anthropic.s4: Give the key an easy name (e.g. "Bible app"), choose a long expiration or "Never", keep Linked account as yourself, and choose the default workspace. Keys without a workspace do not work in this app.
anthropic.s5: Copy the key. It starts with sk-ant- and is shown only once.
anthropic.s6: Come back to the app and paste it on the next screen.
anthropic.note: A Claude subscription (Pro, Max, etc.) is separate from API charges. Company accounts with settings such as zero data retention (ZDR) cannot be used directly from the app.

gemini.s1: Open Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) and sign in with your usual Google account. You type your password only on Google's page.
gemini.s3: Tap "Create API key". If asked for a project and this is your first time, choose "Create API key in new project". A project is how Google groups your usage.
gemini.s4: Copy the new key. It starts with AIza.
gemini.s5: Come back to the app and paste it on the next screen.
gemini.note: On the free tier, what you send may be used to improve Google services and may be reviewed by people. Do not send sensitive details such as church members' names. With a billing account it is not used for training. Free use has request limits.

get_key.common: Never send your key to anyone or share a screenshot of it. If you think it leaked, delete it on the provider's site, create a new one, and replace it in Settings.
